issues.description: Hydration error: progress bar width mismatch between server ('width:5%') and client ('width:15%'). This causes full root re-render with client content, multiple 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' errors, and the red '1 error' toast.
issues.element: Progress bar div with inline style width
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, the progress bar width is computed dynamically (likely using state or Math.random() or currentQuestion index) on render. The server renders with one value (5% = question 0 of 20, or similar) while the client renders with a different value (15%), indicating the progress calculation uses client-only state that isn't initialized consistently, or uses something non-deterministic.

issues.description: Progress counter shows 'Question 1 of 3' on step-3 page. If this is step-3 in the flow, the question counter should either start from a higher number or the step routing is mismatched.
issues.root_cause: The questionIndex state is initialized to 0 on mount, so it always shows 'Question 1 of 3' regardless of which step URL is loaded.

fixes.reason: Track mounted state so progress bar width uses a consistent value during SSR/hydration
Use '0%' on server render to prevent server/client width mismatch that causes hydration error. After mount, the correct client value is used.
